scope: Android Flutter voice background playback adds a separate mediaPlayback foreground service for an already user-started session. LiveKit signaling, ICE, deployment and routing configuration are unchanged.
static_review: PASS: the Dart join path synchronizes service admission after a successful user-started LiveKit join; platform policy is Android-only, and deafen/leave/dispose stop the service. No RTP/RTCP proxy or server-side media change was introduced.
physical_acceptance: NOT_RUN: Android emulator RTP and decoded samples do not prove acoustic output or close the physical Android/iPhone release gate.
